verdict.rationale: Recruitee has a documented REST API with bearer-token authentication that can create and list candidates, create offers, and add profile fields. Its webhooks push events to external endpoints and keep 30 days of request logs. Together these allow non-interactive scripted automation, but only through raw HTTP calls, with no headless or CI-specific tooling. Tokens are created manually in the UI, and the probe found no machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all candidate paths returned 404). Missing for 10: official CLI or SDK, CI/headless usage guidance, OpenAPI spec, programmatic token provisioning, independent or hands-on corroboration of automated use.
